trigger: Find Dr. Ames in the hospital hallway.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Truckee Meadows General runs on one generator and a lot of flashlights. Beds in the hallway. A man in scrubs sleeping standing up.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: If you're not bleeding, you're in the wrong building. If you are, take a number. They're on the wall.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: I'm a mechanic. Avila sent word your generator's surging.

choices.text: I need antibiotics for a home clinic.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: ...Can you? God. Yes. And the other thing. There's a fuel truck stuck on level three of the parking ramp.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Everyone needs antibiotics. I need diesel. Maybe we can help each other.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Five hundred gallons in a tanker on level three. People are living up there. They won't let my staff near it.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Because the Guard would shoot someone, and then I'd have to treat them. Please.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Thank you. Take this empty jug. The tanker is in the hospital parking garage, level 3 — there's a spare in the ramp locker if you need one. Pump's dead; you'll need to gravity-feed it.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Bring the diesel to the loading dock. I'll make it worth your while. And your nurse friend's while.

nodes.speaker: ames
nodes.text: Fair enough. Nobody's fight. That's the problem with everything.
